$comment: Mod catalogue. One entry per swappable mod asset, keyed by generation where the two cars differ. See mx5-mod-modelling-brief.md §8 for the schema and §7.1 for how `slot`/`optionId` map onto the controls carData.json already defines. `scripts/validate-mod.mjs` reads this file and checks each exported .glb against its entry.
$slots: `slot` is a CarConfig field name and `optionId` an id already present in carData.json's aeroParts/wheelStyles for that slot. A mod with slot:null has no control yet and cannot ship — see brief §7.1.
$anchors: `anchors` names base-asset nodes the mod must reach. blender/anchors.json holds their measured boxes; the validator asserts the exported mod comes within `anchorToleranceMm` of each, which is the machine-checkable form of 'nothing floats'.
$attribution: `derivedFromBaseMesh: true` means the geometry was derived from a CC-BY car asset and ATTRIBUTION.md must record the modification. See brief §4.

mods.$note: Phase 0 step 4 of the brief. A 200mm cube sitting on the ND boot lid, material MOD_BodyPaint so the existing paint picker recolours it with no new code. Proves the whole pipeline before any real mod is built. Delete once Phase 1 starts.
